reading.purpose: Chapter body text inside the reader iframe.

shadows.name: soft
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for book covers and card-like content surfaces (.elevated-soft).

shadows.name: floating
shadows.purpose: Heavier lift for elements overlaying other content directly.

motion.name: press-nudge
motion.purpose: Tactile 'pressed into the page' cue on buttons.

motion.name: sheet-slide
motion.purpose: Bottom sheets (TOC drawer, reader toolbar) enter from the viewport edge instead of fading in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Default call-to-action button; square corners, solid ink fill.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #040505; color: #fff9ee; padding: 0 10px; height: 32px; border: none; border-radius: 0; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: rgba(4,5,5,0.8); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #695d4a; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Ghost Icon Button
components.description: Icon-only nav control used in the sticky header (search, menu, overflow).
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { background: transparent; color: #1f1c0f; width: 32px; height: 32px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: none; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { background: #f0e8d4; } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px #695d4a; }

components.name: Book Card
components.description: Library grid item: rounded cover with resting soft shadow and hover deepen.
components.css: .ds-book-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px; } .ds-book-card-cover { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 0.525rem; border: 1px solid rgba(196,199,199,0.4); box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(31,28,15,0.04); background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2b241c, #c9a84c); transition: box-shadow 0.2s; } .ds-book-card-cover:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 24px rgba(31,28,15,0.12); } .ds-book-card-badge { position: absolute; top: 0; right: 0; background: rgba(255,249,238,0.95); font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #444748; padding: 4px 10px; border-bottom-left-radius: 0.525rem; }

components.name: Bottom Sheet
components.description: TOC drawer / reader toolbar: slides up from viewport edge, rounded top corners only, border instead of shadow.
components.css: .ds-sheet { display: flex; flex-direction: column; max-height: 85dvh; background: #f5edd9; border-radius: 1.05rem 1.05rem 0 0; border-top: 1px solid #eae2ce; } .ds-sheet-handle { width: 64px; height: 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #c4c7c7; margin: 12px auto 16px; } .ds-sheet-header { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; font-size: 24px; letter-spacing: 0.05em; padding: 0 24px 20px; border-bottom: 1px solid #eae2ce; } .ds-sheet-item { text-align: left; padding: 8px 24px; border: none; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; font-family: 'Plus Jakarta Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; color: #1f1c0f; } .ds-sheet-item:hover { background: #f0e8d4; } .ds-sheet-item-active { background: #f2e0c8; color: #695d4a; }

components.name: Sticky Header
components.description: Translucent blurred header with hairline top/bottom dividers.
components.css: .ds-header { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 80px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 20px; background: rgba(255,249,238,0.85); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); border-top: 0.5px solid #eae2ce; border-bottom: 0.5px solid #eae2ce; } .ds-header-title { font-family: 'Cinzel', serif; letter-spacing: 0.08em; font-size: 20px; color: #1f1c0f; }

narrative.overview:
Librune reads like a physical folio: warm cream paper, an ink-black spine of UI chrome, and a gold-on-dark cover accent that echoes traditional bookbinding. The reading surface is set in serif type on soft parchment tones, while the architectural chrome around it — buttons, toolbars, the sticky header — stays crisp, sharp-cornered, and quiet, so it never competes with the page. Book covers, bottom sheets, and panels are the "paper objects" of the system: they get soft rounded corners and a consistent gentle lift, as if resting slightly above the surface beneath them. Depth is soft and consistent rather than occasional — every card-like surface carries the same low ambient shadow at rest, not just on hover, reinforcing the sense of physical layered pages.

The system rejects flat, hard-edged material-design card language for controls (no rounded buttons) while embracing it for content objects (rounded covers and sheets) — the split is deliberate: controls are tools, content is the book.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment palette in light mode, near-black ink in dark mode — never a cold neutral gray.
Serif display (Cinzel, wide letter-spacing) for titles; serif body (Literata) for reading; sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) for UI chrome only.
Sharp rectangular controls (buttons: rounded-none) against soft rounded content objects (covers, sheets: rounded-xl/rounded-3xl).
Consistent soft ambient shadow as a resting-state signature, not just a hover effect.

rules.name: The Cover Accent Rule
rules.body: cover-dark and cover-gold are reserved for book-cover placeholder gradients and never used as UI chrome colors.

rules.name: The Ink Inversion Rule
rules.body: Primary is never a fixed hex — always the current theme's ink-on-paper extreme. Use the --primary token so dark mode inverts correctly.

rules.name: The Serif-For-Content Rule
rules.body: Any text meant to be read (titles, chapter text) uses a serif; any text that helps the user operate the app uses the sans.

rules.name: The Resting Lift Rule
rules.body: Content objects (book covers) carry .elevated-soft at rest, not only on hover — depth communicates 'this is a physical object'.

rules.name: The Object/Control Split
rules.body: Round it if it's read or held (covers, sheets, popovers). Keep it square if it's pressed (buttons, controls). Never round a button to match a card's radius.

dos: Do keep all button/control corners square (rounded-none) — never introduce a rounded button variant.
Do give content objects (covers, sheets, popovers) a rounded, soft-lifted treatment (.elevated-soft + rounded-xl/rounded-3xl).
Do pair serif type (Cinzel/Literata) with anything the user reads, and sans (Plus Jakarta Sans) with anything the user operates.
Do use the --primary token (never a hardcoded hex) for anything meant to invert correctly between light and dark mode.
Do reserve cover-dark/cover-gold strictly for book-cover-related surfaces.
donts: Don't round a button or chip to match card radius — it breaks the control/content split.
Don't add a drop shadow to bottom sheets; their elevation cue is the top border + rounded-top-corners + slide animation, not shadow.
Don't introduce a cold neutral gray; all neutrals in this system are warm parchment/ink tones.
Don't use the sans UI font for reading-surface body text, or the serif reading font for buttons/nav labels.
